# Urban Health Project

> A student-run nonprofit pairing first-year University of Cincinnati medical
> students with community health organizations in Greater Cincinnati and
> Northern Kentucky for eight-week summer internships, since 1986.

## Key pages
- [About](https://urbanhealthproject.org/about.html): Mission, history, and program overview
- [Sites](https://urbanhealthproject.org/sites.html): Partner organizations interns work with
- [Funders](https://urbanhealthproject.org/funders.html): The patrons, sponsors, and partners whose donations support the program
- [Get Involved](https://urbanhealthproject.org/become_involved.html): How to apply as a summer intern, Co-Director, donor, or Advisory Board member
- [Alumni](https://urbanhealthproject.org/alumni.html): Every Urban Health Project member since 1987
- [Media](https://urbanhealthproject.org/media.html): Social media and the annual Community and Homeless Resource Map
- [Contact](https://urbanhealthproject.org/contact.html): Reach the current Co-Directors
- [Privacy Policy](https://urbanhealthproject.org/privacy.html): What information this site collects and how it's used

## Donate
- [Donate via the University of Cincinnati Foundation](https://foundation.uc.edu/donate?id=693a5ba0-791b-4c01-9b41-0f506f4f8a02): Donations are processed entirely by the UC Foundation, not this site
